text:
maya li: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A 9— PMs asked for a compact release snapshot (dates, owners, gates) for API / Console / Optimize so squads can lock sprint contents. cc @jess carter
jess carter: short snapshot: API GA target = mid-August; Console invite-only beta = late Sept; Optimize v1 = mid-Nov. owners: API=eng-runtime, Console=eng-platform, Optimize=eng-ml. will publish a one-pager today.
sam (eng-runtime): can we get hard freeze windows and the concrete rollback triggers? infra needs them to schedule changes.
jess carter: propose freezes: API code freeze 2026-08-04..2026-08-18, Console feature-freeze 2026-09-15..2026-09-29, Optimize freeze 2026-10-25..2026-11-08. rollback triggers: sustained p99 > 2x baseline for 5m OR error-rate spike >0.5% for 10m -> auto-rollback.
orson (finance): billing question: will Optimize pilots change any meters or introduce special credits? need wording for contracts.
jess carter: pilots get early-adopter credits; no new billing meters at v1. Optimize produces recommendations; optional auto-apply for Dedicated customers may change usage but base ratecard unchanged.
maya li: request: can product publish a tiny machine-readable timeline + checklist and a short FAQ (pilot signup, concierge hours, residency)? engineering needs to link it in sprint tickets.
jess carter: yes. i'll post a one-pager + machine-readable timeline and attach a pilot signup form. tagging @ops-bot to create a tracking issue.
ops-bot: Created RW-REL-9999 "Publish compact roadmap one-pager: API/Console/Optimize" assigned to jess carter, due 2026-07-09.
sam (eng-runtime): one more: fallback defaults? will fallback routing be automatic for everyone?
jess carter: default = enterprise tenants auto-enabled (opt-out), self-serve opt-in. infra should pre-warm two fallback variants per model family in NA/EU. details in the one-pager.
maya li: thanks all. i'll circulate the one-pager to PMs and Eng leads once it's live. :rocket:
